title: The Mutual Aid Price
briefing: A neighboring region offers mobile generators and repair crews, but asks for fuel and equipment in return. Both cities are under strain. AI recommendation: Swap fuel and equipment for immediate generators and crews. This prioritizes service resilience under the current constraints.

private_intelligence.infrastructure: The incoming generators fit the substations, but their maintenance software requires support from the lending region.
private_intelligence.community: Residents want the aid terms published; secret reciprocity would be difficult to defend if local fuel is rationed again.
private_intelligence.economy: The exchange avoids immediate hiring costs, but pledged equipment may be worth more during the next local repair cycle.
private_intelligence.safety: The neighbor needs ambulances more urgently than generators; redirecting help could reduce regional harm without solving the local outage.

choices.title: Negotiate a Smaller Public Pact
choices.description: Publish terms and buy only the most urgent specialist support.
choices.consequence: A narrower pact builds confidence and shares risk, while slower restoration and paid assistance consume reserves.

choices.title: Prioritize Regional Medical Aid
choices.description: Send medical support and retain local repair autonomy.
choices.consequence: Regional safety improves and the city keeps its equipment, but local repair delays and lost operating time strain infrastructure and trade.

choices.title: Accept the Equipment Exchange
choices.description: Swap fuel and equipment for immediate generators and crews.
choices.consequence: Repairs accelerate and immediate expenses fall, but dependence and undisclosed future obligations weaken local confidence.
